authorization.summary: The Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2026, Division C of Pub. L. 119-103 (Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027, issued September 2, 2026), extends IIJA Divisions A-C and the related FAST Act and MAP-21 provisions through December 11, 2026. GovInfo lists no later surface transportation law through Pub. L. 119-136 (October 22, 2026). Authorization after December 11, 2026 is unknown.

obligations.name: Metropolitan transportation plan (MTP) update

appliesTo.threshold: Every MPO. Cadence depends on air quality designation.

obligations.cadence: At least every 4 years in nonattainment and maintenance areas; at least every 5 years in attainment areas. Minimum 20-year horizon at adoption.
obligations.trigger: Expiration of the prior plan's update window; an MPO may revise at any time.
obligations.deliverable: Adopted MTP with financial plan and system performance report.
obligations.approver: MPO board adopts. In nonattainment and maintenance areas FHWA and FTA make the conformity determination (see mpo-conformity).

openplanHome.note: RTP cycles carry documents and review windows; no update-deadline calculation from attainment status.

obligations.name: Metropolitan transportation improvement program (TIP) update

appliesTo.threshold: Every MPO, with the State and public transportation operators.

obligations.cadence: Covers no less than 4 years; updated at least every 4 years; update cycle must be compatible with the STIP cycle.
obligations.trigger: Expiration of the current TIP; amendments as projects change.
obligations.deliverable: TIP with financial plan in year-of-expenditure dollars and a description of the TIP's anticipated effect toward the MTP performance targets.
obligations.approver: MPO and the Governor approve; FHWA and FTA approve it through the STIP.

openplanHome.note: Program types are RTIP, STIP, ITIP, TCEP, local measure and OWP/UPWP. No federal TIP type, no 4-year window, no amendment log, no target-effect section.

obligations.name: Unified planning work program (UPWP) or simplified statement of work

appliesTo.threshold: UPWP required in TMAs. An MPO outside a TMA may use a simplified statement of work with State, FHWA and FTA approval.

obligations.cadence: Covers the next 1- or 2-year period.
obligations.trigger: Start of each work program period.
obligations.deliverable: UPWP by major activity and task: who performs it, schedule, products, funding by source.
obligations.approver: FHWA Division Administrator accepts the work program (23 CFR 420.111(a)); FTA under Circular C 8100.

openplanHome.note: Work program preparation, review and period tracking exist and feed My Work (work_program_reviews, work_program_periods).

obligations.name: Annual listing of obligated projects

appliesTo.threshold: Every metropolitan planning area; State, transit operators and MPO prepare it together.

obligations.cadence: Annual, no later than 90 calendar days after the end of the program year.
obligations.trigger: End of the program year.
obligations.deliverable: List of projects with 23 U.S.C. or 49 U.S.C. Chapter 53 funds obligated in the preceding year: TIP amount, amount obligated, amount remaining.
obligations.approver: No approval; published under the MPO's TIP participation criteria.

openplanHome.note: Funding awards hold one obligation_due_at date, not a program-year listing against TIP amounts.

obligations.name: Metropolitan planning process self-certification

appliesTo.threshold: All metropolitan planning areas.

obligations.cadence: At least every 4 years, concurrent with submittal of the entire proposed TIP for STIP approval.
obligations.trigger: TIP submittal.
obligations.deliverable: State and MPO certification that the process meets the listed federal requirements (planning, conformity, Title VI, DBE, ADA and others).
obligations.approver: Submitted with the TIP to FHWA and FTA.

obligations.name: Federal certification review of a TMA planning process

appliesTo.threshold: MPOs in a transportation management area (TMA): urbanized area over 200,000, or designated on request.

obligations.cadence: No less than once every 4 years.
obligations.trigger: FHWA and FTA schedule.
obligations.deliverable: Documentation and site review; federal certification report.
obligations.approver: FHWA and FTA jointly certify.

obligations.name: Safety performance targets (PM1)

appliesTo.threshold: Every MPO; may support the State target or set its own quantifiable target.

obligations.cadence: Annual, not later than 180 days after the State reports its targets in the HSIP annual report (due August 31).
obligations.trigger: State HSIP annual report.
obligations.deliverable: Five targets for the same calendar year as the State; VMT method if rate targets are set.
obligations.approver: MPO board; reported to the State in a mutually agreed manner.

openplanHome.note: Safety holds crash evidence and a high-injury network; no target record or 180-day clock.

obligations.name: Pavement, bridge, reliability, freight and CMAQ targets (PM2 and PM3)

appliesTo.threshold: MPOs whose area includes any part of the applicable network or area; CMAQ measures only where applicable.

obligations.cadence: 4-year targets each 4-year performance period, set within 180 days after the State sets its targets; revisit within 180 days if the State adjusts a supported 4-year target at the midpoint.
obligations.trigger: State Baseline Performance Period Report, due October 1 every 4 years (2018, 2022, 2026). The 2026-2029 period's MPO targets fall due about 180 days after October 1, 2026.
obligations.deliverable: Targets reported to the State; baseline and progress reported in the MTP system performance report.
obligations.approver: MPO board.

obligations.name: Transit asset and transit safety targets

appliesTo.threshold: MPOs with public transportation providers setting targets under 49 U.S.C. 5326(c) and 5329(d).

obligations.cadence: Not later than 180 days after the relevant provider establishes its targets.
obligations.trigger: Provider target adoption (TAM annual targets, PTASP annual safety targets).
obligations.deliverable: MPO transit targets coordinated with providers.
obligations.approver: MPO board.

obligations.name: CMAQ performance plan

appliesTo.threshold: MPO serving a TMA with population over 1,000,000 representing a nonattainment or maintenance area, subject to 23 CFR 490.105(f)(6) exceptions.

obligations.cadence: Biennial, on the State biennial performance report schedule.
obligations.trigger: State Baseline and Mid Performance Period reports (October 1).
obligations.deliverable: Baseline congestion and emissions, 2- and 4-year targets, CMAQ projects and their expected contribution.
obligations.approver: Submitted to FHWA by the State DOT.

obligations.name: Transportation conformity determination for the MTP and TIP

appliesTo.threshold: MPOs in nonattainment or maintenance areas.

obligations.cadence: No less frequently than every 4 years for each of the MTP and TIP, then a 12-month grace period before lapse.
obligations.trigger: Also within 2 years of listed triggers, such as EPA finding new motor vehicle emissions budgets adequate; and MTP or TIP amendments that add non-exempt projects.
obligations.deliverable: Regional emissions analysis and conformity determination.
obligations.approver: MPO and U.S. DOT (FHWA and FTA).

openplanHome.note: Model runs produce screening outputs only; no conformity analysis.

obligations.name: Metropolitan planning area boundary review

appliesTo.threshold: Every MPO, with the State and transit operators.

obligations.cadence: After each decennial Census.
obligations.trigger: Census Bureau urbanized area release.
obligations.deliverable: Reviewed and, if needed, adjusted planning area boundary agreed with the Governor.
obligations.approver: MPO and Governor by agreement.

obligations.name: Public participation plan adoption or revision

appliesTo.threshold: Every MPO.

obligations.cadence: No fixed federal cycle; the MPO periodically reviews effectiveness.
obligations.trigger: Initial adoption or any revision: minimum 45-calendar-day public comment period first.
obligations.deliverable: Adopted participation plan, posted online and sent to FHWA and FTA for information.
obligations.approver: MPO board.

openplanHome.note: Engagement runs comment periods; no participation-plan record or 45-day check.

obligations.name: Long-range statewide transportation plan

appliesTo.threshold: Every State.

obligations.cadence: No fixed federal cycle: the State continually evaluates, revises and periodically updates it.
obligations.trigger: State schedule.
obligations.deliverable: Plan with minimum 20-year horizon.
obligations.approver: State.

openplanHome.note: RTP is built for regional plans; no statewide plan kind.

obligations.name: Statewide transportation improvement program (STIP), federal

appliesTo.threshold: Every State, for all areas; MPO TIPs are included without change.

obligations.cadence: Covers no less than 4 years; updated and submitted at least every 4 years.
obligations.trigger: Expiration; amendments also need joint approval.
obligations.deliverable: STIP with State self-certification of the statewide and nonmetropolitan process.
obligations.approver: FHWA and FTA jointly approve.

openplanHome.note: The Programs 'STIP' type is California's CTC STIP, a different, state-law document.

obligations.name: Review of the nonmetropolitan local official consultation process

appliesTo.threshold: Every State.

obligations.cadence: At least once every 5 years.
obligations.trigger: Five years since the last review.
obligations.deliverable: Review with a comment period of at least 60 calendar days directed to county and municipal associations and regional planning agencies.
obligations.approver: State; FHWA and FTA receive the process document for information only.

obligations.name: Strategic highway safety plan (SHSP) update

appliesTo.threshold: Every State.

obligations.cadence: No later than 5 years from the date of the previous approved version.
obligations.trigger: Five years since the last approved SHSP.
obligations.deliverable: Updated SHSP developed with safety stakeholders.
obligations.approver: Governor or delegated State official approves the plan; FHWA Division Administrator approves the update process.

openplanHome.note: Safety evidence exists; no statewide plan record.

obligations.name: Vulnerable road user safety assessment update

appliesTo.threshold: Every State; consults local governments, MPOs and RTPOs representing high-risk areas.

obligations.cadence: With each SHSP update.
obligations.trigger: SHSP update.
obligations.deliverable: Quantitative assessment of vulnerable road user fatalities and serious injuries, high-risk areas and a program of projects.
obligations.approver: State, as part of the SHSP.

obligations.name: HSIP annual report with safety targets

appliesTo.threshold: Every State.

obligations.cadence: Annual, no later than August 31.
obligations.trigger: Annual.
obligations.deliverable: HSIP report through FHWA's online tool, including the five PM1 targets for the next calendar year.
obligations.approver: FHWA Division Administrator receives it.

obligations.name: Biennial performance reports and 2- and 4-year targets

appliesTo.threshold: Every State; measures apply where the network or area exists.

obligations.cadence: Baseline report October 1 every 4 years (next after 2026: 2030); mid-period report October 1 of the third year (2028); full-period report October 1 after the period ends.
obligations.trigger: Performance period start (January 1 for most measures; October 1 of the prior year for the emissions measure).
obligations.deliverable: Baseline, 2- and 4-year targets, progress, and attached MPO CMAQ performance plans.
obligations.approver: FHWA receives and makes significant-progress determinations.

obligations.name: Transportation asset management plan (TAMP)

appliesTo.threshold: Every State, for NHS pavements and bridges.

obligations.cadence: Plan and development processes updated at least every 4 years; FHWA consistency determination by July 31 each year.
obligations.trigger: Four years from the last process certification; amendments go to FHWA at least 30 days before the next consistency deadline.
obligations.deliverable: Updated TAMP and processes; annual implementation evidence.
obligations.approver: FHWA certifies processes and determines consistency.

obligations.name: State freight plan update

appliesTo.threshold: Each State receiving National Highway Freight Program funds.

obligations.cadence: Not less frequently than once every 4 years; 8-year forecast period.
obligations.trigger: Four years since the last plan.
obligations.deliverable: State freight plan.
obligations.approver: State; FHWA reviews.

openplanHome.note: Freight analysis exists in Models; no plan record.

obligations.name: Carbon reduction strategy update

appliesTo.threshold: Every State, in consultation with its MPOs.

obligations.cadence: Not less frequently than once every 4 years.
obligations.trigger: Four years since the last strategy.
obligations.deliverable: Carbon reduction strategy.
obligations.approver: Submitted to the Secretary for certification.

openplanHome.note: Carbon Reduction Program authority runs with the extension through December 11, 2026.

obligations.name: State planning and research (SPR) work program

appliesTo.threshold: States using FHWA planning and research funds.

obligations.cadence: [VERIFY] 23 CFR 420.111 requires a work program acceptable to FHWA but states no period.
obligations.trigger: Use of FHWA planning and research funds.
obligations.deliverable: Work program with tasks, cost estimates, federal share and match by fund.
obligations.approver: FHWA Division Administrator.

openplanHome.note: Built for regional work programs.

obligations.verifyNote: Read 23 CFR 420.111 in full; no period stated. Did not read 23 CFR 420.115 or FHWA division guidance on SPR period length.

obligations.name: FHWA Title VI implementing plan and accomplishment report

appliesTo.threshold: Every State highway agency.

obligations.cadence: Annual updated implementing plan; yearly accomplishments-and-goals report; annual program-area reviews.
obligations.trigger: Annual.
obligations.deliverable: Updated Title VI plan and accomplishment report; reviews of subrecipients (cities, counties, planning agencies).
obligations.approver: FHWA approves or disapproves the plan.

openplanHome.note: Data Hub's Title VI panel is a transit service-equity calculation, not a program document.

obligations.name: DBE overall goal

appliesTo.threshold: FHWA primary recipients and FTA Tier I recipients set goals; FTA Tier II recipients keep a reduced local program.

obligations.cadence: Every 3 years by August 1, on the operating administration's posted schedule; uniform report data by December 1 after each fiscal year (26.11).
obligations.trigger: Three-year goal schedule.
obligations.deliverable: Overall goal methodology with consultation and published notice.
obligations.approver: FHWA or FTA.

openplanHome.note: 49 CFR 26.45 was amended at 90 FR 47980 (October 3, 2025); the August 1 three-year cadence remains in the text.

obligations.name: National Transit Database (NTD) annual report

citations.label: 2026 NTD Full Reporting Policy Manual, Reporting Due Dates and Exhibit 5

appliesTo.threshold: Recipients and beneficiaries of Section 5307 or 5311, and Chapter 53 recipients that own, operate or manage transit capital assets. States report for 5311 subrecipients and file a statewide summary.

obligations.cadence: Annual, four months after fiscal year end (June 30 year end: October 31; September 30: January 31; December 31: April 30).
obligations.trigger: Fiscal year end.
obligations.deliverable: Annual report with auditor and CEO certifications per reporter type.
obligations.approver: FTA closes out the report; failure to report can make the entity ineligible for Chapter 53 funds.

obligations.name: FTA triennial review

citations.label: FTA Triennial Reviews page, updated January 20, 2026

appliesTo.threshold: Section 5307 recipients.

obligations.cadence: At least once every 3 years.
obligations.trigger: FTA schedule.
obligations.deliverable: Recipient information request responses and site review; findings and corrective actions.
obligations.approver: FTA.

obligations.name: FTA state management review

citations.label: FTA State Management Oversight page, updated January 20, 2026

appliesTo.threshold: States administering Sections 5305, 5309, 5310 and 5311.

obligations.cadence: [VERIFY] FTA's current page states no interval.
obligations.trigger: FTA schedule.
obligations.deliverable: Review of state program management.
obligations.approver: FTA.
obligations.verifyNote: The current FTA page lists programs reviewed but no cadence. A search returned a 2013 FTA SMR workbook describing a triennial cycle; it was not opened and is not current. Did not read Circular 9040.1G or the FY26 Comprehensive Review Contractor's Manual.

obligations.name: Transit asset management (TAM) plan update

appliesTo.threshold: Chapter 53 recipients that own, operate or manage capital assets; group plan sponsors (often the State) for Tier II participants.

obligations.cadence: Entire plan updated at least once every 4 years; at least a 4-year horizon.
obligations.trigger: Four years since the last update; the update should coincide with the TIP or STIP cycle.
obligations.deliverable: TAM plan.
obligations.approver: Provider's accountable executive, who is responsible for TAM practices (49 CFR 625.5); plan approval step not read in 625.25.

obligations.name: TAM annual targets and NTD condition reports

appliesTo.threshold: Same as the TAM plan; sponsors file consolidated reports.

obligations.cadence: Targets for the next fiscal year at least once every fiscal year; annual data report and annual narrative report to the NTD.
obligations.trigger: Fiscal year.
obligations.deliverable: State of good repair targets, condition data, narrative of progress.
obligations.approver: Accountable executive approves each annual target.

obligations.name: Public transportation agency safety plan (PTASP) annual review and certification

appliesTo.threshold: Chapter 53 operators; excludes operators funded only by Sections 5310 and 5311 unless they run rail fixed guideway. States may draft plans for small providers.

obligations.cadence: Annual review and update; annual safety performance targets; annual certification of compliance.
obligations.trigger: Annual, on the agency's documented timeline.
obligations.deliverable: Updated PTASP with targets.
obligations.approver: Board of directors or equivalent; direct recipient or State certifies to FTA; State Safety Oversight Agency approves rail plans.

obligations.name: FTA annual certifications and assurances

appliesTo.threshold: Applicants for Chapter 53 grants.

obligations.cadence: Annual, as part of the grant application.
obligations.trigger: Federal fiscal year; FTA publishes the list annually.
obligations.deliverable: Signed consolidated certifications and assurances.
obligations.approver: FTA.
obligations.verifyNote: The statute allows one consolidated annual document and directs annual publication. A Federal Register search for FTA documents since January 1, 2025 found no certifications notice; the FY2026 or FY2027 list and its due date were not located.

obligations.name: FTA Title VI program

citations.label: FTA Circular 4702.1B, Chapters I-6 (gg), III-1, IV-1, V, VI

appliesTo.threshold: Direct and primary recipients (transit providers, MPOs, State DOTs) submit to FTA; subrecipients submit to their primary recipient.

obligations.cadence: Every 3 years; subrecipients on a schedule the primary recipient sets.
obligations.trigger: Three years since FTA concurrence.
obligations.deliverable: Title VI program: notice, complaint procedures, language assistance plan, participation plan, and recipient-type requirements.
obligations.approver: Recipient's board or governing entity (State DOT: Secretary of Transportation) before submittal; FTA concurs.

openplanHome.module: Data Hub Title VI service equity; Engagement
openplanHome.note: OpenPlan keeps an adopted Title VI policy and a service-equity calculation; no program document or 3-year clock.

obligations.verifyNote: Cadence verified. Content is in flux: the June 11, 2026 DOT rule removes disparate-impact liability from 49 CFR part 21 and names the circular's equity analyses as disparate-impact-related. FTA's circular page still lists C 4702.1B.

obligations.name: Fixed-route service standards monitoring and equity analyses

appliesTo.threshold: Fixed-route providers operating 50 or more fixed-route vehicles in peak service in an urbanized area of 200,000 or more.

obligations.cadence: Service monitoring at least every 3 years, reported in the Title VI program; service and fare equity analyses before major service changes and fare changes.
obligations.trigger: Title VI program cycle; major service change; fare change.
obligations.deliverable: Monitoring results and equity analyses approved by the board.
obligations.approver: Board; FTA reviews in the Title VI program.

openplanHome.module: Data Hub Title VI service equity
openplanHome.note: Calculates tract service equity against an adopted policy; no service-change or fare-change trigger.

obligations.verifyNote: Circular text read. The June 11, 2026 DOT rule calls these analyses disparate-impact-related and says submissions should no longer need disparate-impact and disproportionate-burden policies. Whether FTA still requires the analyses was not determined; no revised circular or FTA notice was found.

obligations.name: Title VI plan and reviews for FHWA subrecipients

appliesTo.threshold: Cities, counties, planning agencies and others receiving federal-aid highway funds through the State.

obligations.cadence: [VERIFY] Set by each State DOT.
obligations.trigger: State review schedule and each federal-aid agreement.
obligations.deliverable: Title VI plan or assurances as the State requires.
obligations.approver: State DOT.

openplanHome.note: Needs per-state adapters.

obligations.verifyNote: 23 CFR 200.9 requires State reviews of subrecipients but sets no subrecipient cadence. State manuals (for example Caltrans LAPM) were not read.

obligations.name: SS4A quarterly performance progress report and SF-425

citations.label: SS4A FY25 General Terms and Conditions (FHWA), sections 13.1-13.2

appliesTo.threshold: FY25 FHWA-managed awards. Each round and each administering agency (FHWA, FTA, NHTSA) has its own terms.

obligations.cadence: Quarterly, on or before January 20, April 20, July 20 and October 20, until the period of performance ends.
obligations.trigger: Executed grant agreement.
obligations.deliverable: Performance progress report (Exhibit C format) and Federal Financial Report SF-425.
obligations.approver: USDOT administering agency.

openplanHome.note: Awards and reimbursement exist; My Work reads one obligation date per award, not a quarterly report series.

obligations.verifyNote: Verified for FY25 FHWA terms only; FY22-FY24 and FTA- and NHTSA-managed terms were not read.

obligations.name: SS4A baseline performance measurement report

citations.label: SS4A FY25 General Terms and Conditions (FHWA), section 14.1

appliesTo.threshold: Implementation Grants, and Planning and Demonstration Grants with demonstration activities.

obligations.cadence: Once, by the Baseline Report Date in Attachment A of the agreement.
obligations.trigger: Executed agreement.
obligations.deliverable: Baseline data for each performance measure with sources, assumptions, variability and precision.
obligations.approver: USDOT administering agency.

obligations.name: SS4A final reports and post-award performance reporting

citations.label: SS4A FY25 General Terms and Conditions (FHWA), sections 13.3, 14.2-14.3

appliesTo.threshold: All FY25 FHWA-managed recipients.

obligations.cadence: Within 120 days after the period of performance; article 14 reporting survives three years after the period of performance.
obligations.trigger: End of the period of performance.
obligations.deliverable: Final performance progress report, final SF-425, and SS4A final report on costs, safety outcomes and lessons learned (IIJA section 24112(g)-(h)).
obligations.approver: USDOT administering agency.

obligations.name: Safety action plan annual progress reporting

citations.label: USDOT Comprehensive Safety Action Plans page (NOFO Table 1, component 7), updated October 30, 2026

appliesTo.threshold: Agencies whose Action Plan supports an Implementation Grant or supplemental planning and demonstration grant.

obligations.cadence: At least annual public and accessible progress reporting; the plan must be finalized or updated between 2021 and May 26, 2026 to qualify in the current round.
obligations.trigger: Action Plan adoption.
obligations.deliverable: Public progress report on fatalities and serious injuries with outcome data; Action Plan posted online.
obligations.approver: Agency; USDOT checks through the self-certification worksheet.

openplanHome.note: Safety can produce the crash evidence; no annual progress report artifact.

obligations.name: ADA self-evaluation, coordinator, grievance procedure and transition plan

appliesTo.threshold: Coordinator, grievance procedure, transition plan and retained self-evaluation records: entities with 50 or more employees. Self-evaluation: all public entities.

obligations.cadence: No federal update cycle. The self-evaluation and transition plan dates (1993, 1992) have passed; the duties are continuing.
obligations.trigger: Structural changes needed for program access; entities with streets add a curb ramp schedule.
obligations.deliverable: Transition plan identifying obstacles, methods, schedule and responsible official; for streets, a curb ramp schedule.
obligations.approver: Public entity; plan open for public comment and inspection.

openplanHome.note: No inventory, schedule or progress record for barrier removal.

obligations.name: Web content and mobile app accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

citations.label: DOJ final rule extending compliance dates, 91 FR 20902 (April 20, 2026)

appliesTo.threshold: Total population 50,000 or more (not special districts): April 26, 2027. Population under 50,000 and all special district governments: April 26, 2028.

obligations.trigger: Compliance date by population and entity type.

obligations.name: California regional transportation plan update
